name: insilico-subtitle-translation
description: Review and translate Insilico English-Chinese SRT subtitles with terminology and cue-boundary QC.

interface.shortDescription: Review bilingual SRTs with terminology and cue-boundary protection.
interface.longDescription: A local workflow for reviewing ChatCut English, translating natural Simplified Chinese, and preventing terms or fixed phrases from being split across subtitle cues.
defaultPrompt: Review this SRT's English terminology and cue boundaries before translating it.
Translate this reviewed English SRT into natural Simplified Chinese without splitting terms across cues.
Run subtitle QC and explain any protected terms split across adjacent cues.
